tools.name: minfraud_score
tools.description: Score a transaction for fraud risk. Returns the overall risk_score (0.01–99), IP risk, disposition, and remaining query funds — the lightest, cheapest assessment. Send at least device.ip_address (plus email/billing/order for a better score). API: POST /minfraud/v2.0/score.

tools.name: minfraud_insights
tools.description: Score a transaction AND get detailed risk insights: IP geolocation, email/address/device attributes, and per-component risk on top of the risk_score. Same request body as minfraud_score. API: POST /minfraud/v2.0/insights.

tools.name: minfraud_factors
tools.description: The most detailed assessment: everything in Insights PLUS risk_score_reasons and per-factor subscores explaining WHY the score is what it is. Same request body as minfraud_score. API: POST /minfraud/v2.0/factors.

tools.name: minfraud_report_transaction
tools.description: WRITE — submits fraud feedback to MaxMind. Report the real-world outcome of a transaction (e.g. it was a chargeback or confirmed fraud) so minFraud can improve future scoring. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: minfraud_insights, minfraud_report_transaction · Public sink: minfraud_score, minfraud_insights, minfraud_factors, minfraud_report_transaction.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: minfraud_insights, minfraud_report_transaction · Public sink: minfraud_score, minfraud_insights, minfraud_factors, minfraud_report_transaction

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
